issue: New entry not persisted across page reload
actual: Added entry "Alpha QA test task" (Priority 7, Mar 11 2026, Completed=yes) appeared immediately in the table and the count went 5→6. After reloading http://localhost:7074/, the table shows only the original 5 seed entries (entry-1..entry-5) and the new entry is gone.

evidence: Add Entry dialog renders input[type=text] for Task Name, input[type=number] for Priority, input[type=date] for Due Date, and a labeled Yes/No toggle button for Completed; each field is labeled with its name.

Configure Fields dialog offers type options Text/Number/Date/Checkbox. Added "Owner" (Text) and "Score" (Number); both immediately appear as table columns, in the toolbar sort options, and as new inputs in the Add Entry form (Owner text input, Score number input). Card view also shows them (verified later).

Priority is input[type=number]. Typing "abc" character-by-character left value "0" (unchanged, validity.valid=true, badInput=false) — non-numeric text cannot be entered/saved. Valid value 7 was accepted and saved, shown as "7" in the table.

Due Date is input[type=date]. Entering the invalid calendar date 02/31/2026 left the input value empty with validity.badInput=true, so it could not be committed. A valid date 2026-03-11 was accepted and saved, rendered as "Mar 11, 2026".

Entry saved with text "Alpha QA test task", number 7, date 2026-03-11, checkbox on, plus Owner "Zoe Meyer"/Score 42. Table shows: Alpha QA test task | 7 | Mar 11, 2026 | check icon | Zoe Meyer | 42. Card view shows the same values with Completed="Yes".
Switching Table→Cards kept all 6 entries and identical field values; statusbar.count stayed "6 entries".

All 6 entries and all 6 field values render in both views with matching content (e.g. entry-2: Review marketing materials / 2 / Jan 18, 2026 / checked / — / —). Empty values render as an em dash "—" in both table and card views.
Entry form: toggle button reads "No" (unchecked) vs "Yes" (checked), semantic value false/true. Table: green lucide-check icon vs muted lucide-x icon. Cards: text "Yes" vs "No".

With no sort active, keyboard drag on card handle moved "Update API documentation" to position 1 in Cards (order 3,1,2,4,5,new). Table view still showed its own order (1,2,3,4,5,new); dragging "Team sync meeting notes" to top in Table gave 5,1,2,3,4,new. Returning to Cards, the card order 3,1,2,4,5,new was retained — each view keeps its own manual order.

Cards: sort select → Task Name gave ascending A→U; re-selecting toggled to descending (status "Sorted by Task Name (descending)"). Table: clicking Priority header gave numeric ascending 1,1,2,2,3,7 with status "Sorted by Priority (ascending)". Switching Cards↔Table each restored its own sort state (Table showed no sort / then Priority asc; Cards kept Task Name desc). Sortable by any of the 6 configured fields.

Before/after sorting by Task Name and Priority the count stayed "6 entries" and every row kept identical field values (e.g. Alpha QA test task | 7 | Mar 11, 2026 | checked | Zoe Meyer | 42; entry-2 | 2 | Jan 18, 2026 | checked | — | —). Only row order changed.

Selecting "Task Name" in the sort control immediately reordered visible cards; sort trigger label became "Task Name" and status bar read "Sorted by Task Name (ascending)"/"(descending)" identifying active field and direction. App remained fully interactive (view switching, search, add entry all still worked afterwards).

issue: Quick search matches internal raw values, not the displayed formatted values
actual: Entry "Alpha QA test task" displays Due Date as "Mar 11, 2026" and Completed as "Yes". Searching "Mar 11" returns "0 entries matching \"Mar 11\"", and searching "Yes" returns "0 entries matching \"Yes\"" (3 entries display Completed=Yes). Searching the raw stored value "2026-03-11" does return 1 entry, proving search runs on raw values only.

evidence: Query "MARKETING" (uppercase) matched "Review marketing materials" — case-insensitive substring match on text values; count updated to "1 entry matching \"MARKETING\"". Clearing the search restored all 6 entries and count "6 entries".

actual: No filter control exists anywhere in the app. The toolbar exposes only Fields, quick Search, Sort, Table/Cards toggle and Add Entry. Table column headers are sort-only buttons with no filter affordance, the Configure Fields dialog has no filter section, and the page text contains no occurrence of "filter" (/filter/i on document.body.innerText = false) in either table or card view, including hidden elements. Therefore filter criteria cannot be defined or cleared.

issue: Cannot verify filter inclusion/clearing — no filtering capability
actual: The app provides no filter criteria UI (see FT-6), so there is no way to apply active criteria or clear them. Only a global quick-search exists, which is not field-specific filtering.

No import entry point exists: no file input (document.querySelectorAll('input[type=file]').length = 0), no Import/Upload/Paste button, and no semtag id matching /import|upload|csv|json/. The Configure Fields dialog only shows the note "Configure fields before importing data." but provides no import action. Import after schema definition and type-mismatch rejection therefore cannot be exercised.
